subject: question about the interpretation of the lavaan results

messages.author: 97801d2860446368
messages.subject: question about the interpretation of the lavaan results
parts:
Hello everyone!
Could someone help me with a question about the interpretation of lavaan results?
The total effect do not correspond to the  direct effect   added to the sum of indirect effects. For example,  totalELEV =   a + (f*b)+(g*c)+(h*d)+(i*e) = -0,099 in my results, but   a = -0.159 plus (f*b)+(g*c)+(h*d)+(i*e) = 0.093 results in -0.066.

modelfdis <- 'AGB ~ a*ELEV

AGB ~ b*SR

AGB ~ c*CVD

AGB ~ d*CWMHmax

AGB ~ e*FDISHmax

SR ~ f*ELEV

CVD ~ g*ELEV

CWMHmax ~ h*ELEV

FDISHmax ~ i*ELEV

CVD ~ j*SR

CWMHmax ~ k*SR

FDISHmax ~ l*SR

CWMHmax ~ m*CVD

FDISHmax ~ n*CVD

fb := f*b

gc := g*c

hd := h*d

ie := i*e

jc := j*c

kd := k*d

le := l*e

md := m*d

ne := n*e

indirectELEV := (f*b)+(g*c)+(h*d)+(i*e)

indirectSR := (j*c)+(k*d)+(l*e)

indirectCVD := (m*d)+(n*e)

totalELEV := a + (f*b)+(g*c)+(h*d)+(i*e)

totalSR := b + (j*c)+(k*d)+(l*e)

totalCVD := c+(m*d)+(n*e)

totalELEV := i+(g*n)+(f*l)

totalSR := j+(j*n)

totalELEV :=h+(g*m)+(f*k)

totalSR := k+(j*m)

totalELEV := g+(f*j)'

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: question about the interpretation of the lavaan results
parts: You used the same names several times when defining the effects. E.g.,

totalELEV := i+(g*n)+(f*l)
totalELEV :=h+(g*m)+(f*k)
totalELEV := g+(f*j)

It seems that lavaan does not throw an error in this case (maybe it should?), but I believe the last version, g+(f*j), will overwrite all previous three versions in the output.

-- Shu Fai
